text:
Sam (SI-Helios): Hey team, Helios customer stuck on onboarding. k8s nodes intermittently fail pulling our private marketplace image; errors show `x509: certificate signed by unknown authority` on one node and `denied: requested access to the resource is denied` on another. They're behind a corporate proxy that does TLS inspection. Need registry whitelist, CA advice, and an auth bypass for testing.

Ana (Partnerships): Looping infra + solutions. @Felix any public IPs/CIDRs and token endpoint we can share?

Felix (Eng-Infra): Registry: registry.market.redwood.ai:443. Published egress addresses are 52.14.10.11 and 52.14.10.12. Token endpoint: https://auth.market.redwood.ai/token. Common root cause: proxy intercepts TLS; container runtime must have the proxy CA under `/etc/containerd/certs.d/registry.market.redwood.ai/ca.crt`. OS CA alone often insufficient.

Rita (Solutions): For the `denied` error, confirm whether imagePullSecrets are set in the deployment or if nodes rely on node-level creds. If proxy mangles Authorization to the token endpoint, pulls will 401/403. Two short-term options: 1) temporary NAT allowlist for their outbound IP, or 2) provide a base64 dockerconfigjson they can preload.

Sam (SI-Helios): They added the proxy's CA to OS store and updated, but containerd still fails. They can't easily change proxy behavior (managed infra).

Felix (Eng-Infra): OS CA != runtime CA path. Need to copy the PEM to `/etc/containerd/certs.d/registry.market.redwood.ai/ca.crt` and restart containerd. Also check systemd drop-in for HTTP_PROXY/HTTPS_PROXY and NO_PROXY to include registry host. Example drop-in: `Environment="HTTPS_PROXY=http://proxy.corp:3128" "NO_PROXY=127.0.0.1,localhost,registry.market.redwood.ai"`.

Omar (Customer Success): Customer asked for a 30m deep-dive today at 17:30 UTC. Can infra join?

Ana (Partnerships): I'll be there. @Felix @Rita pls confirm availability.

Felix (Eng-Infra): I can join. Also recommend we open a 1-hour troubleshooting window and make the image briefly public so they can validate pulls without auth. We can revert after.

infra-bot: visibility-change: registry.market.redwood.ai/helios-agent:2.0.1 set to public for troubleshooting by infra-team (window 2026-06-12T17:00Z - 2026-06-12T18:00Z).

Rita (Solutions): If we make it public, provide this sample secret + note to remove when done: `kubectl create secret generic reg-secret --from-file=.dockerconfigjson=/path/to/config.json --type=kubernetes.io/dockerconfigjson`. For node-level pulls, they'll need to place creds in the runtime config.

Sam (SI-Helios): I'll ask them to validate during the public window and capture containerd logs: `journalctl -u containerd -u kubelet -n 200`. Also asked for `openssl s_client -connect registry.market.redwood.ai:443 -showcerts` output.

Omar (Customer Success): Thanks. Action items: Felix to draft cert install steps and NO_PROXY example, Rita to share sample dockerconfigjson + note about node vs pod secrets, Ana to run the scheduled call invite.

Ana (Partnerships): Call invite sent for 17:30 UTC. Good catch on the node vs pod creds; we'll call that out. :white_check_mark:
